what_next: 1. Do not place. Keep close/plan.json as the warm start; gen.py --check reproduces it byte for byte (judge re-run, judge/gen_check_judge.log).

2. The 4 open connections are an in-field escape shortage on U1's column-17 east balls, not a band outside U1. Each far end reaches 4.92 M free cells, and the U1 east cut at x 52.9 still has 212 of 398 lanes free. Within the brief's levers 4 is a floor: the author's 40+ seeds, the 0-of-114 swap screen, and the judge's carve and sealer survey. Ball swaps in bank 14 or bank 16 cannot add in-field capacity; bank 16 is electrically legal (all VCCO 3.3 V, all ports LVCMOS33) but is not recommended. Re-pathing the XADC supplies onto one other layer is not available: they do not connect on Bottom even on the bare board.

3. A product-scope decision is needed from the user, not just the standing routing authorisation; stage 9 open question 1 is still open. Option A, the fastest placeable board: defer UART flow control (RTS#/DTR#/CTS#) and accept LED0_R and CHAN6 (both DEFER class) unconnected in rev A. The judge's candidate lev/F0/fc4_plan.json (md5 364f980eea5514ef82bab16adb46296d) already closes 134 of the 136 connections that remain required, including UART_FT_TXD; route_emit is clean and the GND, plane, webs and extra gates pass. Stage 13 would then remove those 5 nets from the U1 side of the schematic and XDC, delete their orphaned dogbones and stubs, and re-gate, review and judge.

4. Option B, the full 140: this needs a structural lever in U1's east field, and none is measured to succeed. Two were measured with no gain: CHAN11+LED2 deferral, and Bottom-reaching lasers allowed in the field. Candidates for a stage-13 model search, each needing authorisation or a product decision: relocate LD0 (LED0_B and LED0_G are among LED0_R's sealers); re-route the XADC supplies around the field; convert the east-field GND through vias that have only a Top fan-out to Top>L2 microvias, at (47.9,9.8999), (48.4001,10.4) and (48.4001,9.8999); and re-negotiate rows D-T x columns 14-19 with these combined.

5. For either option, stage 13 should remove no placed copper without replacement unless its net is deferred, drop the 4 collinear overlaps, run the full gate set with --require-complete, then the reviewer and the judge. One Phase II follows, re-deriving the change list from the passing plan.
